## What happened

Change notice CHG-0144 records the Cost centre recode. The change took effect from 2023-04-01. It concerns the recoding of cost centre information within the relevant financial records. This notice provides a clear record of the change and the date from which it applies.

## Cause

The change was required as part of the Finance system upgrade. The upgrade provided the basis for updating the cost centre information and implementing the recode.

## Effect

As a result, Screening cost centres renumbered. Users referring to screening financial information should use the updated cost centre references after 2023-04-01. Existing records and related processes may therefore show the revised numbering. Questions about this notice should be directed to the service desk, quoting CHG-0144.
